---
title: "News"
listing:
  id: news-posts
  contents: posts
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  # Without `image`, Quarto does not keep an empty thumbnail column.
  fields: [date, title, subtitle, description, categories]
  categories: true
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  feed:
    title: "JuliaBayes Blog & News"
    description: "Articles, announcements, and community news from JuliaBayes."
    image: rss-icon.png
    language: en
# Quarto loads MathJax on every listing page. The listing shows no maths.
html-math-method: plain
include-after-body:
  - category-pills.html
---
